scope: First captured frame inside the frozen server executable, after ignoring non-executable or external-library addresses. Optimized inline sites can share function names. No full stack attribution claim; requested bytes verified against profile header.

websocket.scope:
Attribute a captured capacity heap to first executable frames in its exact image.

Optimized inline sites can share symbols. This is allocation-site evidence, not
complete call-stack attribution. Bucket bytes must sum to the profile header.
